summary: Tulare County, CA ground lookout built circa 1935 by the Tulare County Fire Department; staffed to at least 1959; FFA lists it gone; a foundation may remain near a communications site.

facts.design: Rough canvas-roofed wood platform on a rock outcrop, with a tent for the observer (register description)
facts.status_note: FFA California list marks it Gone; register gives the removal date as unknown and says a rock foundation may still be visible
facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection, Tulare Unit (Cal Fire TTU), per the register; Forest Lookouts places the site in Sequoia National Forest

events.note: Register gives the build date as circa 1935; the Tulare County Fire Department originally constructed the site
Mrs. Ira W. Wilson and her husband worked the lookout; per The Oregonian story of November 25, 1959, as quoted by Forest Lookouts, the couple quit after a bear moved into their tent
Registered April 24, 2020; nominated by Brad Eells; US 2050, CA 156

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register names the Cal Fire Tulare Unit as administrator; the Forest Lookouts page places the site in Sequoia National Forest (15S-28E-9). Both are reported in the story and neither is dropped.

notes_for_editor: Two detailed pages plus an FFA list row. The Oregonian story is only available second-hand, quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; no original was found. The register text has the typo 'at lease'; the evidence quote keeps the source spelling and the story says 'at least'. The staffing row uses the Wilsons' departure (November 1959) as the last known staffing, not a formal end date. No photo with a URL found. No access statement in any source, so facts.access is omitted. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 5 page reads for this tower.
